:megaphone: I'm looking for a postdoc to join my group at MIT! (https://zardini.mit.edu/)

We make the design of complex, interconnected systems mathematically rigorous and computable. We build the theory — compositional co-design, applied category theory, compositional optimization, contracts — turn it into algorithms that actually scale, and apply it to autonomy stacks, layered control architectures, multi-agent systems, agentic AI, and networks such as mobility and energy. Deep theory at one end; solvers, toolboxes, and case studies validated with state-of-the-art industry partners at the other.

I am looking for someone with a PhD, completed or imminent, in a related field, who brings genuine compositional and structural thinking together with the ability to implement it: you design the algorithm, you prove the properties, and you ship the code. I care about curiosity for architectures — how decision-making, control, learning, and hardware should be organized rather than merely tuned — and about independence and taste in choosing problems worth solving.

To apply, complete this short form: https://forms.gle/SLsaiqxCYpsPLXGg7

Review is rolling, with a first pass on September 15, 2026. The position stays open until filled. Please share with anyone who fits! :folded_hands:
